description: Incidenti - Strade coinvolte is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Emilia Romagna. Strade in cui sono avvenuti gli incidenti. Vengono raccolti incidenti rilevati dalle seguenti forze dell'ordine: Carabinieri Borello (CB), Carabinieri Cesena (CA), Carabinieri Macerone (CM), Carabinieri San Carlo (CS), Polizia Stradale Cesena (PS), Polizia Municipale Cesena (PM). Non vengono rilevati incidenti avvenuti sull'autostrada A14. Coverage: Regione Emilia Romagna. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Emilia Romagna. Its tags are incidenti, strade. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
